EEOC CHARGE OF DISCRIMINATION — Charge No. WB-2024-08712
Charging Party: Priya Natarajan
Respondent: Hartwell Analytics, Inc.
Date Filed: 08/22/2024
Basis: Age; National Origin; Retaliation (Title VII); FMLA Retaliation

PARTICULARS:
I was employed by Hartwell Analytics from March 2014 to August 8, 2024 as Director of Analytics. I am 54 years old and of South Asian (Indian) national origin.

In January 2023, I was reassigned under VP Brendan Coulter. Mr. Coulter made repeated age- and origin-coded remarks ("we think differently — generationally"; "bring in someone more current"; "refresh the team"). On 06/12/2023 I filed an internal complaint with HR. No corrective action was taken.

In February 2024, I received my first below-"Exceeds" rating in eight years.

On 03/14/2024 I was diagnosed with cancer. I took FMLA leave from 04/01/2024.

On 07/08/2024, while still on FMLA, I was notified my position was being "eliminated." I was offered a non-equivalent IC role at a $42,000 pay reduction, or severance.

Within 30 days, the company posted "Senior Director, Analytics Strategy" with materially similar responsibilities. It was filled by a 31-year-old white woman.

I believe I was discriminated against on the basis of age, national origin, and use of FMLA leave; and retaliated against for my June 2023 internal complaint.

EEOC DETERMINATION (10/14/2024):
"The Commission finds reasonable cause to believe that Respondent discriminated against Charging Party on the basis of age and retaliated against her for protected activity, in violation of the ADEA and Title VII. Conciliation has failed. Notice of Right to Sue is issued."
